feature: Optional local multilingual history embedding runtime

scenarios.name: Both apps include the optional runtime dependency licenses
scenarios.given: the optional History runtime is included in the Mac and iPhone/iPad applications
scenarios.then: every resolved package, including the embedding, tensor-file and tokenizer packages, retains its matching revision and license

scenarios.name: Installed multilingual runtime produces comparable local vectors
scenarios.given: explicit verified local MPNet assets and eligible German, Spanish, Japanese and Korean history text with no Apple coverage advertised by the fallback adapter
scenarios.when: the native adapter embeds passages and matching queries
scenarios.then: finite normalized 768-dimensional vectors share the pinned MPNet identity and queries never mix Apple model tags

scenarios.name: Existing Apple routing remains the default
scenarios.given: no optional runtime or a language outside the four optional languages
scenarios.then: the existing Apple adapter receives unchanged text and language and its vector is retained

scenarios.name: Oversized multilingual passages do not discard their tail
scenarios.given: a passage exceeding the 128-token model bound with a different topic at its end
scenarios.then: no prefix-only vector is returned so complete original text remains eligible for keyword search

scenarios.name: Cancelled and unavailable local runtimes do not publish vectors
scenarios.given: a cancelled request or an explicitly selected missing local model directory
scenarios.then: no vector or network fallback is produced and an unrelated stored model cannot receive a query vector

scenarios.name: German meaning search retains the existing semantic acceptance contract
scenarios.given: explicit installed local MPNet assets and German translations of the existing eight-topic corpus, eight paraphrases, ten unrelated queries and three small-talk records with Apple unavailable so the optional model itself is evaluated
scenarios.when: actual HistoryIndex indexes and searches the corpus using unchanged production ranking parameters
scenarios.then: at least six paraphrases find the intended first Related conversation without keyword credit, unrelated queries yield no Related or meaning-only Ask passages, and the first two small-talk passages have no semantic vector

scenarios.given: explicit installed local MPNet assets and Spanish translations of the existing eight-topic corpus, eight paraphrases, ten unrelated queries and three small-talk records with Apple unavailable so the optional model itself is evaluated

scenarios.name: Short queries reach every compatible stored embedding model
scenarios.given: an explicitly installed MPNet runtime and an index containing both MPNet and Apple model tags
scenarios.when: German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, English and ambiguous short queries are embedded
scenarios.then: each compatible stored model receives exactly one finite query vector regardless of the guessed query language, while unknown model tags receive none

scenarios.name: Eligibility upgrades discard stale persisted semantic vectors
scenarios.given: a persisted history index containing filler vectors from the former mean128-v1 embedding policy
scenarios.when: the current optional runtime opens that index and synchronizes the same conversation
scenarios.then: legacy derived vectors are removed before reuse, unchanged original text is reconsidered under the new policy, and conversation content is preserved without downloading assets

scenarios.name: Additional languages preserve installed Apple support
scenarios.given: Apple Spanish assets and an explicitly selected local optional model, either present or missing
scenarios.when: History embeds detected or explicitly tagged Spanish and eligible or filler text
scenarios.then: Apple model tags and vectors remain unchanged, rejected filler stays absent, stored Apple queries stay compatible and cancelled work publishes no vector

scenarios.name: Apple-first routing discards old overriding vectors
scenarios.given: an unchanged Spanish conversation has derived vectors from the prior optional-model routing policy
scenarios.when: the current native adapter opens and synchronizes that History index
scenarios.then: old optional vectors are discarded before reuse and rebuilt with the currently available model while original text and language are preserved; installed Apple support takes precedence

scenarios.name: iPhone History routing follows actual installed language support
scenarios.given: the iOS host may or may not have Apple Spanish embeddings and optional local assets are present or missing
scenarios.when: History embeds detected and explicitly tagged Spanish and queries the selected stored model
scenarios.then: available Apple vectors and eligibility decisions are preserved; otherwise installed MPNet supplies a normalized local vector and missing assets yield none; the selected model receives a nonempty query and pre-cancelled work yields nothing
